notes: «عن أبي جعفر ع» is an Imam written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); his later words «قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ع» are not a new link
«أبيه» after زكريا بن محمد is a bare relation
The Prophet's sayings inside the story («وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ص») carry no isnad of their own and are not stored as routes
